content.text: The structure is clear. Next I'll pull every cite and penalty line across all 58 files to check for formatting variations.

input.command:
cd /tmp && cat > $TMPDIR/ext.py <<'EOF'
import re,glob,os,sys
D='/tmp/r2run-9695ugpk/data/text'
for f in sorted(glob.glob(D+'/*.txt')):
    t=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    cases=re.split(r'Recommendation to IURC',t)[1:]
    for c in cases:
        cn=re.search(r'Case Number:\s*(\S+)',c)
        cite=re.search(r'finds the following violation\(s\):\s*(.*?)\n\s*\n\s*The Advisory',c,re.S)
        pen=re.search(r'recommends the following civil penalty:\s*(.*?)\n\s*\n\s*Abstentions',c,re.S)
        print(os.path.basename(f),'|',cn.group(1) if cn else None,'|',repr(cite.group(1).strip()) if cite else None,'|',repr(pen.group(1).strip()[:150]) if pen else None)
EOF
python3 -I $TMPDIR/ext.py | head -400; python3 -I $TMPDIR/ext.py | wc -l

import re,glob,os,json
from collections import Counter
D='/tmp/r2run-9695ugpk/data/text'
def clean(s): return re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s or '').strip()
CITE_RE=re.compile(r'IC\s*8\s*[-\s]?\s*[lI1S8]\s*[-\s]?\s*26\s*-?\s*([0-9lIOS][^\n]*)')
def base_of(rest):
    # rest = text after "8-1-26-"; base = leading number part + single-char parens
    m=re.match(r'\s*([0-9lIOS]+)',rest)
    if not m: return None
    num=m.group(1).replace('l','1').replace('I','1').replace('O','0').replace('S','8')
    b=num; pos=m.end()
    while True:
        t=re.match(r'\s*\(\s*([A-Za-z0-9lI])\s*\)',rest[pos:])
        if not t: break
        ch=t.group(1)
        if ch in 'lI' : ch='1'
        b+='('+ch+')'; pos+=t.end()
    return b
def headline(pen):
    if not pen: return 0
    p=pen.replace('$$','$')
    m=re.search(r'\$\s*(\d{1,3}(?:,\s?\d{3})+|\d+)',p)
    if not m: return 0
    return int(re.sub(r'[,\s]','',m.group(1)))
recs=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob(D+'/*.txt')):
    t=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    for pi,pg in enumerate(re.split(r'=== page \d+',t)):
        if not re.search(r'recommendation\s+to\s+iurc',pg,re.I): continue
        case=re.search(r'Case\s+Number:?\s*(\d[\w-]*)',pg,re.I)
        if not case: continue   # blank template form, no case number
        resp=re.search(r'Respondent:\s*(.*?)\s*(?:Other Party|Case Number)',pg,re.S|re.I)
        resp_s=clean(resp.group(1)) if resp else None
        cm=CITE_RE.search(pg)
        cite_raw=clean(cm.group(0)) if cm else None
        base=base_of(cm.group(1)) if cm else None
        pm=re.search(r'recommends\s+the\s+following\s+(?:civil\s+)?penalty:?(.*?)Abstentions',pg,re.S|re.I)
        pen=clean(pm.group(1)) if pm else None
        recs.append(dict(file=os.path.basename(f),page=pi,case=case.group(1),resp=resp_s,cite=cite_raw,base=base,pen=pen,hp=headline(pen)))
json.dump(recs,open(os.environ['TMPDIR']+'/final.json','w'),indent=0)
print('cases',len(recs))
print('no cite:',[ (r['file'],r['case']) for r in recs if not r['base']])
print('base counts:',Counter(r['base'] for r in recs).most_common())
